description: This file defines the MatrixFunctions class which provides various matrix-related calculations such as sequence generation, determinant, inverse, multiplication, and identity matrix creation within the PhpSpreadsheet library.

classes.name: MatrixFunctions
classes.description: Provides static methods for performing various matrix calculations such as sequence generation, determinant, inverse, multiplication, and identity matrix creation.

methods.name: getMatrix
methods.description: Converts input parameter to a Matrix object after validation and processing.

methods.name: sequence
methods.description: Generates a sequence of numbers in an array based on provided rows, columns, start, and step parameters.

methods.name: determinant
methods.description: Calculates the determinant of a matrix.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of a matrix.

methods.name: identity
methods.description: Creates an identity matrix of specified dimension.
